name: Gash Rabbet
source:
As Orion, the wanderer slays the ancient forest god, she finds the offering to the now deceased god - a girl named Sphene.

With Sphene now under Orion's care, they must now tread lightly to ensure their survival.

But Orion has never traveled alone. By her side is her dearest and closest companion; her blade by the name of Selene. 

[From [url=https://uberthemeh.itch.io/gash-rabbet]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当流浪者猎户座杀死了古老的森林之神时，她找到了献给已故之神的祭品——一个名叫斯芬妮的女孩。

由于斯芬涅现在由猎户座照顾，他们现在必须小心谨慎以确保生存。

但猎户座从未独自旅行过。她的身边有她最亲爱、最亲密的伙伴；她的剑名为塞勒涅。

[来自[url=https://uberthemeh.itch.io/gash-rabbet]itch.io[/url]]
